messages:
Ravi (People Ops): Heads-up — Anya (new PM) says her passport renewal at the DC consulate got bumped. Start date is Monday. We need an I-9 solution + laptop for day 1. Thoughts?
Mei (Hiring Manager): Team prefers not to move the start. Can she do remote day 1? We'll do virtual welcome.
Anya (New Hire): Hi! Yes remote is fine. I can visit the consulate next week but not within the 3-day I-9 window. I can also go to a local notary or certified mail center.
Ravi (People Ops): Ok. Options: 1) Employer-authorized representative via a local notary (we supply Agent Authorization form), 2) Trusted third-party I-9 verification service (we have vendor list), 3) If she can swing by our DC office within 3 days, we can do it on-site.
Anya (New Hire): I'm in NW DC (Adams Morgan). Going to office is tough that week. Notary or verification service works. What's the cost for vendor?
Ravi (People Ops): Vendor usually charges ~$35-50. We'll expense it. I'll email the vendor options and the Agent Authorization template.
onboarding-bot: @Anya secure upload: https://redwood-internal/onboard-upload (72h).
Anya (New Hire): Uploaded driver's license + renewal receipt. Notary option: "Capital Notary Services, 16th St NW".
Carlos (IT): For devices: we can ship a corporate loaner (MacBook) with VPN/SSO pre-provisioned. Standard domestic shipping 2 business days. Need shipping address. We can also do a remote image if she prefers her own device.
Anya (New Hire): Please ship to: 2101 18th St NW, Apt 2B, Washington, DC 20009. Corporate laptop please.
Ravi (People Ops): Great. Carlos please use express and mark as "new-hire first day". Also schedule Okta invite and MFA enrollment 24h prior.
Carlos (IT): Submitted ticket IT-6012. Shipping via UPS Express. Okta invite to be sent tomorrow.
Mei (Hiring Manager): Benefits Q: will she be able to enroll on day 1? Also state tax residency?
Ravi (People Ops): Benefits portal opens on first paid day. She can enroll remotely. Regarding state tax: if she lives in DC, we'll default to DC withholding but she should confirm her domicile. Payroll will send DC forms.
background-bot: Background check note: vendor flagged a name-match alert. Anya please e-sign alias confirmation at link emailed. Clearance pending until signed.
Anya (New Hire): Signed the alias form and confirmed DC residence.
Ravi (People Ops): Scheduling: 9:00AM welcome with People Ops, 10:00AM product intro, 11:00AM benefits walkthrough (20m). I'll send calendar invites and record the benefits session.
Mei (Hiring Manager): I'll do the team intro + virtual lunch.
Anya (New Hire): Thanks everyone  excited to start. Appreciate covering the verification vendor fee.
Ravi (People Ops): Action checklist: 1) Ravi: send Agent Authorization and vendor list, expense pre-approval (HR-4120). 2) Anya: complete notary/vendor verification and keep receipt. 3) Carlos: ship IT-6012 loaner and send Okta invite. 4) Payroll: push DC tax forms on day 1. Escalate if any step misses the 3-day I-9 window. :white_check_mark: 
onboarding-bot: Reminder set: "Upload I-9 verification receipt" scheduled +3 days.
